purpose: Join the already-derived 801 observed CO2 flag-1 identities that contribute to R3 bins 61-64 against their TAPE3 main slots and complete adjacent negative-IFLG companion groups, without repeating the CAND/R3 census or claiming physical coupling-group closure.

scope.target_identity_source: join.target_unique_identity_summary, filtered to encoded-MOL species 2 and original_IFLAG 1
scope.purpose_of_blocks: Every block containing one of the already-joined CO2 target contributor identities; no whole-file scan.
scope.association_contract: Each expected key must occur exactly once at its identified block/slot with matching encoded MOL and IFLAG=1. Count every immediately following negative-IFLG slot through the next nonnegative slot, including across block boundaries within the bounded range; flag-1 target expects exactly one adjacent negative companion. Any target whose negative group remains open at the end of the bounded range is unresolved/fail, never silently treated as complete.
out_of_scope: No reread/recount of raw CAND or R3 traces; the pinned derived report already joins all 6,072 target R3 updates to 837 phase-3 reason-12 identities.
No claim that the 801 CO2 identities exhaust every physical coupling partner, all line candidates, or all computational candidates outside the observed R3 contributor set.
No coefficient/YI/GI/SPPSP reconstruction or exact term-transfer claim; this reader validates stored record identity and adjacent companion association only.
No solver, model, build, raw AER, or OD/TAPE output scan.

tape3.verification: Use the previously recorded whole-file pin and stat identity as provenance. This audit itself performs no new whole-file digest; it hashes only the header and selected panel byte ranges and verifies file stat identity before/after.

prior_three_pair_audit.scope: Three selected layer-21 CO2 main/companion pairs only; retained as narrow prior evidence, not reused as the 801-row answer.

expected_summary.interpretation_on_pass: Scoped observed-target record-association census only. This does not establish a named physical group or full physical cancellation closure.
